items.title: AWS Lambda now supports 90-minute function timeout on Lambda Managed Instances
items.blurb: AWS Lambda now supports a 90-minute function timeout for asynchronous and event source mapping (ESM) invocations on Lambda Managed Instances (LMI) , a 6x increase from the previous 15-minute limit.

items.title: AWS Lambda now supports Graviton5-powered EC2 instances on Lambda Managed Instances
items.blurb: AWS Lambda now supports AWS Graviton5-powered C9g, C9gd, M9g, and M9gd instances on Lambda Managed Instances .

items.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base adds APIs and console support for debugging document-level access control
items.blurb: AWS announces the CheckIngestedDocumentAcl and GetIngestedDocumentAcl APIs for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, giving customers a self-service way to debug document access issues and audit document-level permissions.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports Confluence Data Center as a native data source connector
items.blurb: AWS announces the Confluence Data Center data source connector for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, a fully managed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) service.

items.title: AWS Transform for .NET modernization is now generally available via CLI
items.blurb: Today, AWS announced the general availability of an AWS-managed transformation for .NET modernization in AWS Transform custom that you can trigger with a single one-line CLI command.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now lets you set specific capacity limits for different types of Tasks and Emails
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now gives contact center managers the ability to set specific capacity limits for different kinds of work.
